mp.pillar: Sustained Dominance: higher positions, longer presence and higher peak positions on Most Popular.
observations: Steal An Egg (105 days), Brookhaven, DONT SPLASH (21 days), RIVALS, Murder Mystery 2 and Blox Fruits lead the cumulative pillar, the same top group as yesterday.
Cook the Chicken (by slapping it), Ragdoll Playground and Street Soccer Pro rose 9 places each, and a dusty trip [🎃HALLOWEEN] and Turbo Soccer rose 7; two soccer games among the five risers is new.
Make Viral Candy! fell 23 places at 20 days, and Fake an Egg (-10), Evermore High (-9), 7 Days Cat-Sitting (-8) and Realistic Ragdoll Playground (-8) also fell.

Five games entered, among them Ragdoll Physics (26 days, no developer products), Survive Your Ideas, Onthel Purwodadi and Eat THE Ice Cream [CH2]; six left, including The Hollow, Make a Cartoon! and Sell a Million Sushi.

By age the median pillar percentile runs from the 40th at 15-42 days to the 61st past a year, with only 12 games between 85 days and a year, so the mid-life trough (H-mp-009, 48%) still can't be tested.
patterns: Updates consistently go with staying power: games more than 28 days past their last update stay far fewer days (r=-0.66), and weekly updaters stay longer (H-mp-018, 65%).

Higher prices tend to go with dominance: a median pass above 149 R$ holds at 73% (H-mp-001), and median products above 400 R$ split days on the chart at r=+0.43, with game age as the likely confounder.
Verified creators (r=+0.28) and studio-scale complexity (H-mp-015, 65%) tend to stay longer, though creator size is partly a result of success.

Among profiled loops, '+1' incrementals (78th median percentile) and combat PvP (67th) sit high while co-op wave survival (13th, 5 games) and obbies (35th) sit low; a test of wave survival is proposed today.
Big evergreens consistently convert fewer visits into favorites (H-mp-010, 84%); this is a lifecycle effect, not a lever.

te.pillar: Monetization Efficiency: earning a high position with modest CCU (Monetization Score ranks position × CCU, lower is better).
observations: Donation hubs again lead efficiency (Summer Donations, Donation Central, Simple DONATIONS), with New Journey, Clover RPG and Build and Burn close behind.
Flee the Facility, Throw Food For Animals, Deagle Arena and the new Ragdoll Physics (no products) are the least efficient: large free audiences with little to buy.

Raise A Catboy (+84), My Trading Card Shop! (+75), Shibuya [Beta] (+73), MAHANAKHON RACING (+65) and Karinderya! (+63) rose most; Candy Kingdom Defense (-69), Evomon (-59), German Moped Days (-51), REDLINER (-50) and Anime Zero (-45) fell most.

Eleven games entered, among them Steal a Superpower! (300+ products), FERAL Animal Survival, Net a Fish!, 1M Clicks To Escape and the 1,981-day-old Car Driving Indonesia; thirteen left, including Pet Simulator X! and several Halloween titles.
Efficiency consistently rises with age, from the 25th median percentile at 15-42 days to the 63rd past a year (H-te-001, 85%).
patterns: High prices consistently pay: median products above 79 R$ split efficiency at r=+0.53 (H-te-005, 91%), and median passes above 399 R$ (H-te-025) and a top pass above 999 R$ (H-te-006) also hold at 91%.
Steal-and-defend-base loops (r=-0.71) and physics sandboxes (r=-0.66) are consistently the weakest earners per player, with 'Egg' (r=-0.75) and 'Steal' (r=-0.73) the worst title keywords.

RPGs (r=+0.45), PvP combat (r=+0.29), roleplay hubs (72nd percentile), tower defense (73rd) and story adventures (70th, 30 games) consistently earn more per player; story adventures are proposed as their own test today.
Complexity (rho=+0.26), servers above 30 players (r=+0.31) and longer descriptions (r=+0.25) consistently go with efficiency, all three also tracking game age.
A roll or luck layer tends to earn more per player (H-te-037, up to 65%); two of today's new entries, Net a Fish! and Steal a Superpower!, sell luck or pack openings.

outliers.note: Rose 84 places at 25 days despite a steal-and-defend loop, the weakest-earning loop overall; a short-lived catch-up of revenue with players (H-te-018) is the likely reason.

tt.pillar: Early Momentum: rapid upward movement on Top Trending, among games 0–4 months old only.
tt.metric: daily position gain on Top Trending
observations: 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] (+37, 29 days), Become the Potato! (14 days), +1 Boxing Battle Evolution and Can You Pass A Driving Test? lead early momentum.
DONT SWIM (+33, 13 days), Steal Eggs From Tsunami! (+30), You and Me in Cali RP (+26) and the 592-day-old Build and Survive (+23) rose most.
Farm Evolution (-25), الشايب (-21), Draw a Flag! (-17), Climb The Rake Tower (-16) and Ragdoll Wars! (-14) fell most; Farm Evolution is the weakest despite 189 products.
Eleven games entered, among them Ragdoll Research (10 days), WRECKED (12 days), South Hell, Create Slime Mart and King Legacy's Halloween update; DONT SPLASH and +1 Venom Evolution left.
Games updated in the last day moved a median -5 against +2 for the rest, so same-day updates still don't show as momentum.
patterns: A skill-based competitive core consistently goes with lower positions among young games (H-tt-054, 75%; within-age effect -0.58), and PvP social play also sits lower (r=-0.34).
Survival framing tends to go with faster climbs (H-tt-048, 69%; r=+0.39), and horror-escape loops hold the 85th median percentile, though only five are scored.
Solo loops tend to climb more slowly (H-tt-008, up to 69%), and a play-with-friends pitch goes with faster climbs within age (+0.45), proposed as a test today.
Luck passes (H-tt-039, 69%) and storage passes (H-tt-038, 70%) tend to go with lower positions at launch, while cosmetic passes went with slower climbs today (r=-0.45) against H-tt-045's direction.
Physics sandboxes split: they hold positions (r=+0.31 for the mechanic) but climb slowly once on the chart (loop r=-0.37), consistent with a wave that enters high and then settles.

uc.pillar: Breakout Popularity: higher positions within Up-and-Coming.
observations: Survive Your Ideas (32 days), Ragdoll Physics (26 days), Ragdoll Research (10 days), DONT SPLASH, MALAM SAMA OPAH and South Hell top the chart: three survival or horror titles and two ragdoll sandboxes.
Be a Soccer Legend (+67), Ragdoll Research (+42), Last Bridge Standing (+41 despite 38% likes), Bubu & Dudu Obby (+33) and Hide In Drawings (+26) rose most.
Escape The Walls (-53), +1 Vampire Evolution (-27), +1 Hamster Smash (-26), Raise A Catboy (-22) and +1 Anime Eyes (-22) fell most; four of the five are '+1' or incremental games.

Thirteen games entered, including Steal a Superpower!, FERAL, Untitled Symbiote Suit Game, Make Your Phone Case!, My iPad and Teach Your Granny How To Drive!; fifteen left, among them +1 Venom Evolution and Minecraft 1.21.4.
The newest games (0-14 days) hold the 78th median percentile against the 48th at 15-42 days (H-uc-005, 61%).
patterns: Horror-escape loops consistently rank high (r=+0.69, 8 games, H-uc-057 at 72%), and the Survival genre (r=+0.53) and survival framing (H-uc-047, 78%) agree.
'+1' incrementals consistently rank lower (H-uc-003, up to 72%), and four of today's five biggest fallers are incremental games.
More badges consistently go with higher positions (H-uc-008, 77%; split at 5, r=+0.48), and selling skips tends to go against them (H-uc-045, 74%).
PvP loops consistently rank lower (H-uc-038, 78%) while co-op loops tend to rank higher (H-uc-019, 69%); solo loops tend to rank lower (H-uc-007, 70%).
Games advertising a live or limited event sit higher (r=+0.29, 8 games), proposed as a test today; Ragdoll titles are 10% of the chart and lean positive (r=+0.31).

outliers.name: Last Bridge Standing
outliers.note: Rose 41 places with a 38% like ratio and 199 products, a curiosity physics game against the like-ratio pattern (H-uc-006).

outliers.name: [🚨] Escape The Walls

summary: The ragdoll wave widened: Ragdoll Physics entered Most Popular and sits #2 on Up-and-Coming, Ragdoll Research jumped 42 places and entered Top Trending, and Ragdoll Playground rose 9 on Most Popular; H-x-021 rises to 75%. Physics sandboxes still earn least per player (r=-0.66), so H-x-002's reach-versus-revenue split holds.

Survival and horror now lead both breakout charts: the top six on Up-and-Coming include four survival or horror titles, 13 Days to Escape leads Top Trending, and DONT SWIM (+33) follows DONT SPLASH; H-x-019 rises to 58%. Survival games still earn less per player on Top Earning (H-te-021, 91%).

Halloween fallout continued but unevenly: +1 Venom Evolution, Grow a Chicken Fighter and Steal A Pet And Ride It left their charts, while King Legacy re-entered Top Trending on a fresh update and a dusty trip rose on Most Popular; H-x-027 holds at 45%.
Competition splits the charts again: a skill-based competitive core goes against Top Trending (-0.46) and Up-and-Coming (-0.33) while PvP combat consistently earns more per player (+0.29).

Gameplay videos are still unlabelled for the seventh run: Dragon Adventures, Creatures of Sonaria, Sol's RNG and Basketball: Zero are frames_ready with 0 frames and no contact sheets. No new outside research was waiting. 53 games were profiled today, eight of them showing an hourglass update-countdown icon (proposed at 20%).
progressions: uc→tt remains the most common transition (200 entries, up from 193, median 2 days), ahead of tt→mp (161, up from 157, median 2 days).
uc→te (125, 5 days), tt→te (116, 4 days) and uc→mp (107, up from 103, 4 days) keep showing breakouts reaching revenue and dominance within about a week, while tt→uc stays at 1.
Ragdoll Physics completed the uc→tt→mp path at 26 days, and Ragdoll Research went uc→tt within its first 10 days.
